description: This PHP class defines acceptance testing methods for interacting with a sidebar in a web application. It provides functions to click on various sidebar elements, including actions, recently viewed items, favorites, and toggle button.

classes.name: SideBar
classes.description: A class extending AcceptanceTester that provides methods to interact with sidebar components during acceptance testing.

methods.name: clickSideBarAction
methods.description: Clicks on a specific action link within the sidebar identified by the link text.

methods.name: clickSideBarRecentlyViewed
methods.description: Clicks on a 'recently viewed' item within the sidebar identified by the link text.

methods.name: clickSideBarFavorite
methods.description: Clicks on a favorite item within the sidebar identified by the link text.

methods.name: clickToggleSideBar
methods.description: Click toggles the visibility of the sidebar.
